title: Adaptive heterogeneous signal sampler and probabilistic anomaly explainer for usage/cost/latency
creator: Avery Chen
description: Introduce an adaptive, heterogeneous signal sampling layer and a probabilistic anomaly explanation service to reduce noise and increase signal quality for usage/cost/latency alerting. This ticket scopes backend work in the console telemetry pipeline and a lightweight explainability API used by the Console and alerting runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline sampling component deployed to telemetry-ingest namespace with feature flag 'hetero-sampler' off by default
End-to-end tests showing 40-60% reduction in low-actionable alerts for synthetic noisy tenants while preserving >95% recall for injected anomalies
Explainability service endpoint /v1/alerts/explain returns probabilistic attribution (top-3 contributing series with posterior probability) within 200ms P95
Console alerting UI can call explain endpoint and render returned attribution in the alert details drawer
Runbook: documented failure modes and fallback (sampling disabled -> deterministic pass-through) in Confluence linked in comments
DR run: automated rollback of sampler config via feature-flag within 15 minutes validated in staging
technical_notes: Sampler design: reservoir + stratified reservoir per-tenant, weighted by recent variance and token-cost exposure
Anomaly scoring: combination of short-window z-score (for spikes) and Bayesian change-point posterior (for sustained shifts)
Explainer output: probabilistic attribution vector with normalized posterior scores and a short natural-language summary template for Console
State: maintain per-tenant lightweight sketch (Count-Min + EWMA) to estimate series importance; persisted to Redis with 1h TTL
Performance: aim for <5% additional CPU on telemetry processors and <10MB Redis per 10k tenants
Backward compatibility: when feature flag disabled, pipeline behaves as today (full ingestion)
rollout_plan: 1) Merge code behind feature flag; run unit and integration tests in CI
2) Deploy sampler to staging with sampling rate 0.1 for low-volume tenants; enable explain endpoint in staging
3) Run canary on 5% of production tenant traffic (low-risk tenants list). Monitor precision/recall and alert volume over 72h
4) Increase to 30% if metrics look good; enable Console explain for beta orgs
5) Full rollout with dynamic tuning knobs and automated rollback if alert volume drops >30% or false negatives rise >5%
6) Post-rollout: 2-week monitoring window and retrospective to tune prior and stratification heuristics
metrics: Alert noise reduction: percent decrease in alerts marked 'no-action' by SRE/users
False-negative rate for injected anomalies in synthetic test harness
Per-tenant cost delta: change in tokens/compute attributed to sampling
Storage overhead: Redis bytes per tenant relative to budget
